title: Classification of Boolean Cubic Forms in Ten Variables
summary: We classify Boolean cubic forms in ten variables up to GL(10,2)-equivalence. The catalog contains all 3691560 nonzero orbits. For every orbit we provide a representative with small monomial count, the stabilizer order, and the alternating rank together with an explicit decomposition. The classification is obtained by rank-stratified enumeration. We verify completeness by the Burnside orbit count and independently by the orbit--stabilizer identity.
